sortieLines.line: Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
⚔️ SORTIE — Ricardo, Ines, Ava take up arms and a day's rations (6,245 kcal from the stores) and walk out to the treeline. Nobody's coming back the same.
⚔️ The Ugly-Eyes mauled Ricardo (-96 health) over 5 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing. — the party falls back to the palisade, dragging their nerve with them. The treeline holds.

🌙 Night. The lingering Ugly-Eyes gorges at the treeline — 1,200 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.
